title: Blood Red Lotus
art_style: High-contrast noir comic book style with chiaroscuro lighting and blood-red accents
short_summary: In the rain-soaked, neon-lit city of New Harbor, private detective Jack Malone investigates the murder of his informant Eddie Chen, uncovering corruption, betrayal, and dark secrets in the city's underbelly.
world_context: New Harbor City, 1950s, a foggy, neon-lit urban environment rife with crime, corruption, and jazz culture.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Rugged Irish-American man, weathered face with stubble, sharp gray eyes, limping gait
quirks: Wears a worn leather trench coat
characters.typical_attire: Worn leather trench coat, fedora hat, slacks, and scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Ex-cop turned private eye, haunted by past failures and driven by a personal code of justice.
characters.motivations: To uncover the truth behind Eddie Chen's death and bring justice to New Harbor's dark streets.

characters.name: Eddie Chen
characters.physical_traits: Asian-American man in his 30s, lean build, short black hair, often wore a battered leather jacket
characters.typical_attire: Worn leather jacket, faded jeans, work boots
characters.backstory: Jack's informant, caught in the crossfire of city crime factions.
characters.motivations: Survival and trying to make a better life despite dangerous connections.

characters.name: Tommy "The Knife" Russo
characters.physical_traits: Stocky Italian-American man, cold eyes, scar on left cheek, always alert
characters.backstory: Mob enforcer with a complicated past and ties to Eddie.
characters.motivations: Loyalty to the mob but burdened by regret.

characters.name: Vagrant Witness
characters.physical_traits: Disheveled, ragged clothes, unshaven, wary eyes
characters.backstory: A homeless man who witnessed suspicious activity near the warehouse.

chapters.chapter_summary: Jack Malone investigates the dockside warehouse where Eddie Chen's body is found. He examines the scene, discovers key evidence, and receives a vagrant's testimony implicating Tommy Russo. Jack makes an anonymous tip to the precinct, heightening the tension.

scenes.scene_description: Jack arrives at the foggy dockside warehouse where the body was found, taking in the eerie atmosphere and setting.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Establishing shot of a fog-shrouded dockside warehouse at night. Rusted metal walls and broken windows loom under dim, flickering floodlights. Thick fog curls around crates and barrels scattered on the wet concrete ground. The distant silhouette of cranes and ships is barely visible. The atmosphere is cold and oppressive. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Establishing the eerie, foggy warehouse setting.
panels.color_palette: desaturated blues and grays with harsh red accent

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Medium shot of Jack Malone stepping cautiously through the foggy dockside, his trench coat collar turned up against the cold. His face is partially obscured by shadow and fog, eyes sharp and alert. The metallic tang of rust and salt seems almost visible in the air. Wet ground reflects the dim light. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack entering the warehouse area, sensing danger.
panels.color_palette: desaturated blues and grays with blood-red accents

pages.page_description: Establishing the foggy, ominous dockside warehouse and Jack's cautious approach.

scenes.scene_description: Jack discovers Eddie's body inside the warehouse, examines the scene closely, and finds key evidence.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Wide shot of the dimly lit warehouse interior. Eddie Chen's body lies sprawled on the cold concrete floor, slick with blood pooling beneath him. Rusted metal beams and crates surround the scene. Sparse light filters through broken windows, casting long shadows. The air is thick with fog and the metallic tang of blood and rust. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Showing the grim crime scene with Eddie's body.
panels.color_palette: desaturated blues and grays with stark red blood accents

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Medium shot of Jack Malone crouching beside Eddie's body, eyes narrowed in concentration. Jack's gloved hand gently touches Eddie's stiff fingers clutching a torn ledger page. The cold concrete floor is stained dark. Dim light highlights the texture of the ledger and Jack's focused expression. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack examining the torn ledger page in Eddie's hand.
panels.color_palette: muted blues and grays with red accents

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Close-up of the torn ledger page clenched in Eddie's pale, stiff fingers. The page is stained with blood and has jagged tears. Nearby on the floor lie a few cigarette butts and a small piece of fabric with glove fibers. The lighting casts sharp shadows emphasizing the texture of the paper and fibers. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Detailing the torn ledger page and surrounding evidence.
panels.color_palette: desaturated blues with red and brown accents

pages.page_description: Jack examines Eddie's body and discovers key evidence in the warehouse.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Medium shot of Jack standing, holding a small evidence bag containing the torn ledger page and cigarette butts. His face is grim, eyes scanning the dim warehouse. The fog swirls around his feet. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack securing evidence and preparing to investigate further.
panels.color_palette: muted blues and grays with red accents

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Close-up of Jack's face, eyes narrowed and focused, lips pressed tight. The fog and dim light create deep shadows on his face, highlighting his furrowed brow and clenched jaw. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack's intense focus as he processes the evidence.

dialogue.text: The torn ledger, glove fibers, cigarette butts... silent witnesses in the fog.

pages.page_description: Jack secures evidence and contemplates the clues in the foggy warehouse.

scenes.scene_description: Jack encounters a vagrant witness who whispers testimony implicating Tommy Russo at the scene.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Medium shot of Jack kneeling down to speak with a disheveled vagrant leaning against a crate. The vagrant's face is shadowed but his eyes are wary and darting. Jack's expression is serious and intent. Fog swirls around their feet. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack questioning the vagrant witness near the warehouse entrance.
panels.color_palette: muted blues and grays with red accents

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Close-up of the vagrant's face, eyes wide and voice hushed, lips parted as he whispers. His face is lined and dirty, with a shadow of fear. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Vagrant whispering testimony about Tommy's presence.

dialogue.text: I saw Tommy... lurking near the docks that night...

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Medium shot of Jack standing, face grim, looking down at the vagrant. His hand is raised slightly, signaling calm but urgency. Fog thickens around them. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack absorbing the vagrant's testimony, preparing to act.

dialogue.text: Thanks for the tip. Stay safe.

panels.color_palette: muted blues and grays with red accents

pages.page_description: Jack receives whispered testimony from the vagrant implicating Tommy Russo.

scenes.scene_description: Jack makes an anonymous tip call to the precinct, the tension thick as the fog.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Medium shot of Jack standing inside a rain-soaked phone booth, gripping the receiver tightly. His face is tense, eyes focused ahead. Neon lights flicker outside, casting red glows on the glass. Fog swirls around the booth. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack making an anonymous tip call to the precinct.
panels.color_palette: desaturated blues with blood-red neon accents

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in High-contrast noir comic book style. Close-up of Jack's hand gripping the phone receiver tightly, knuckles white. Raindrops streak the glass of the booth. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Close-up on Jack's tense grip during the call.

dialogue.text: This is an anonymous tip. Tommy Russo was at the warehouse that night.

pages.page_description: Jack makes an anonymous tip call to the precinct, heightening the tension.
